verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Marketing API that manages contacts (mailchimp-docs-4, mailchimp-docs-15) and email reports that show which recipients clicked links (mailchimp-docs-21, mailchimp-docs-22). Transactional webhooks push per-message send, open and click events (mailchimp-docs-18), but that is a push mechanism, not a way to read a contact's history on demand. Nothing in the pack documents an API endpoint that returns one contact's history of what was sent, opened and clicked. Missing for 10: a documented per-member activity or engagement-history API endpoint, an explicit way to read per-contact open/click data through the API rather than the UI reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
